headline: Is he slow to commit, or is he wasting my time?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through the backs, but your hand found the one with everything arranged on purpose.
Every object has its place on the open table.
You asked whether he is slow to commit or wasting your time. The deliberate table is the part I keep returning to.
He has not committed, and the delay has left you choosing between two explanations.
Right where deliberate attention would become commitment, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Now let me look at what's sitting there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You reached without seeing him and chose the calmest figure here.
He hangs by one ankle, and his face is calm.
You asked what his delay means. This card makes me look at the calm face inside the pause.
Still, the future is held, and you do not know why.
Something stands between his presence and a named future. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding the future…
c: You turned the Fool. The picture was hidden, yet your hand went to the one who hadn't packed for everything.
The bundle on his stick is small and lightly tied.
You asked whether the unsettled commitment hides a motive. The light bundle catches my attention.
But the commitment has not settled, and the time is yours to feel.
The thing that has hold of the future keeps it lightly carried. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of this…
